prompt:
One continuous SIX-SECOND seamless IDLE LOOP of the coral ribbed spinner luggage mascot Travi on the supplied handmade paper workshop stage. The supplied FIRST FRAME and LAST FRAME are the SAME IMAGE: begin and finish in this exact composition, pose, expression and lighting, ready to repeat smoothly with no visible reset.

The character is already present and waiting for the traveller to choose a destination. NO entrance, no rolling across the stage, no world reveal. Keep him enthusiastically attentive and subtly alive, like a helpful little porter keeping someone company.

Acting: a very small, slow, relaxed side-to-side body sway of about one degree, over one complete gentle cycle; wheels remain planted at exactly the same floor marks. His paper luggage tag softly moves a few millimetres and settles back. A tiny friendly eyebrow lift and slight change in the warm delighted open smile around second two, then the smile returns to its original shape. One quick natural blink near second three: close and reopen within 0.15 seconds. Bright cream-and-navy eyes are fully open and alert otherwise. The raised folded-paper hand makes just one small wrist adjustment, never a large repeated wave. By second five he eases into the original pose; hold the original pose for the final half-second.

IDENTITY LOCK: the exact same tall CORAL upright hard-shell spinner with vertical ribs, navy perimeter zipper band and corners, four realistic dark swivel caster assemblies, brass twin telescopic rails with navy pull grip, separate short grab handle, cream palm luggage tag, exactly two folded-paper arms, original face size and proportions. Preserve the same fine cardstock grain and warm grounding shadow. Keep the suitcase closed.

CAMERA AND SET LOCK: fixed locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no reframing, same portrait composition and character size throughout. The teal paper wall, curved theatre wings, cream paper floor, closed teal folio and blank cream tickets at the lower LEFT are completely motionless. Preserve the large empty upper wall for live text and empty lower floor for live controls. Nothing new enters these areas.

Motion is restrained, elegant and physical. Match the supplied reference frame precisely at both ends. No bored half-lidded eyes, long eye closure, bouncing, dancing, extra limbs, floating wheels, rubber distortion, warping ribs, changing hardware, breathing background, scene drift, camera movement, scenery, letters, logos, buttons, UI, confetti or sound. Silent.
idea: Travary — Travi stays enthusiastically attentive while waiting for a destination
